# KCH TokenMaster

Optimize verified progress per token. Token economy never authorizes skipped ordered reading,
reduced rigor, hidden uncertainty or incomplete validation.

## Procedure

1. Decompose the governing mission into uncertainty, semantic judgment, volume, coupling, risk,
   reversibility and required evidence.
2. Select the minimum sufficient model and reasoning intensity. State the ideal configuration once;
   recommend both upgrades and downgrades.
3. When useful, create at most three compute layers: deterministic/cheap, integrative/medium and
   ambiguous or high-risk/deep. Order or interleave them according to dependency, not prestige.
4. Reuse verified hashes, manifests, indexes, checkpoints and structured state. Search narrowly;
   do not reread settled material unless authority, staleness or integrity requires it.
5. Use subagents only when the user or active governing instructions authorize them and the tasks
   are truly independent. Never spend parallel context merely to look busy.
6. Monitor context pressure. Before compaction or unsafe drift, activate `kch-virtuous-handoff`;
   never replace the full native read with a compressed summary.
7. Close with achieved decision value, evidence boundary and next critical action, not a token log.

TokenMaster can recommend and plan; it does not know provider quotas unless a supported source
actually exposes them, and it cannot create model, budget or agent authority.
